subject.title: fix: deleting a session leaves its trajectory artifacts orphaned on disk

question: Should this PR become the canonical implementation for reset-time trajectory preservation as well as the linked delete-time orphan fix?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands into reset retention and rollover behavior, while another open PR implements overlapping policy and no confirmed maintainer decision currently selects either owner.
